summary.en: Lam Chak, charged with conspiracy to defraud over the JPEX virtual asset trading platform case, held a press conference on Thursday to defend a sanitary product brand endorsed by his girlfriend. Speaking to HK01 afterwards, he said he respects the legal process and is not afraid of a potential jail term, adding that he is currently barred from leaving Hong Kong due to the proceedings.
summary.zh_hans: 涉及虚拟货币交易平台 JPEX 涉诈骗案、被控串谋诈骗罪的林作，今日召开记者会为女友代言的品牌平反，会后接受《香港01》访问谈及官司近况。他表示尊重法律程序，需要时间配合，直言不怕坐牢。由于涉及司法程序，他目前受限制无法离港。
summary.zh_hant: 涉及虛擬貨幣交易平台 JPEX 涉詐騙案、被控串謀詐騙罪的林作，今日召開記者會為女友代言的品牌平反，會後接受《香港01》訪問談及官司近況。他表示尊重法律程序，需要時間配合，直言唔驚坐監，「我唔係一個好識驚嘅人嚟」。由於涉及司法程序，他目前受限制無法離港。

title.en: JPEX case: Lam Chak charged with conspiracy to defraud, says he is not afraid of jail

截至9月30日　宏福苑90.4%業主已完成簽署買賣協議
title.zh_hans: 截至9月30日　宏福苑90.4%业主已完成签署买卖协议
title.en: 90.4% of Wang Fuk Court owners signed sale agreements as of Sept 30

summary.zh_hant: 房屋局局長何永賢表示，截至9月30日，90.4%宏福苑業主已完成簽署《買賣協議》；業主須於10月15日或之前完成簽約。政府跨部門「解說專隊」會在特設銷售計劃的揀樓過程中繼續全力支援居民，包括接待、舉辦睇樓團及講座講解資訊。
summary.zh_hans: 房屋局局长何永贤表示，截至9月30日，90.4%宏福苑业主已完成签署《买卖协议》；业主须于10月15日或之前完成签约。政府跨部门“解说专队”会在特设销售计划的拣楼过程中继续全力支援居民，包括接待、举办看楼团及讲座讲解资讯。
summary.en: Housing Secretary Winnie Ho said 90.4% of Wang Fuk Court owners had signed sale agreements as of September 30, ahead of the October 15 deadline. A cross-departmental support team will continue assisting residents through the flat-selection process under the special sales scheme, including site visits and briefings.

Singer Kaho Hung has released his new single "Quit Sugar Fail" (戒糖失敗), the third instalment of his magazine-concept album "KIKI". The track is composed by newcomers Yungie and Amber Cheng with lyrics by Yoyo Tsang. Its music video stars Venus, sister of P1X3L member George, and sees Hung devouring cakes on camera — joking he ate a year's worth. He also revealed the "KIKI" EP will arrive in the first half of next year.
summary.zh_hans: 洪嘉豪推出新歌《戒糖失败》，为杂志概念专辑《KIKI》的第三波主打。新歌由两位新晋创作人 Yungie 及郑伟唯作曲、曾乐彤填词；MV 找来 P1X3L 成员欧镇灏的妹妹 Venus 担任女主角，Kaho 在 MV 中狂吃蛋糕，笑言差点吃足一年的蛋糕分量。他又预告《KIKI》EP 将于明年上半年正式推出。
summary.zh_hant: 洪嘉豪推出新歌《戒糖失敗》，為雜誌概念專輯《KIKI》的第三波主打。新歌由兩位新晉創作人 Yungie 及鄭偉唯作曲、曾樂彤填詞；MV 找來 P1X3L 成員歐鎮灝的妹妹 Venus 擔任女主角，Kaho 在 MV 中狂食蛋糕，笑言「差唔多食足一年嘅蛋糕份量」。他又預告《KIKI》EP 將於明年上半年正式推出。

title.en: Kaho Hung drops new single "Quit Sugar Fail", devours cakes in MV

summary.en: Mainland Chinese visitors flocked to Hong Kong's shops and malls on the second day of the National Day golden week holiday, with Mong Kok's shopping districts packed by noon and long queues forming outside camera-gear hub Sim City. Hong Kong recorded over 277,300 mainland arrivals on the first day of the break, about 47 per cent of total inbound passengers, and more than 68,800 had arrived by 10am on Friday. The city expects about 1.29 million mainland travellers over the week-long holiday.
summary.zh_hans: 国庆黄金周假期第二日，大批内地旅客涌入香港各大商场及店铺，旺角购物区中午已人头涌涌，知名相机商场星际城市门外大排长龙。假期首日本港录得逾27.73万内地旅客入境，占总入境人次约47%；次日截至上午10时已有逾6.88万人次到港。预计整个黄金周本港将迎接约129万内地旅客。
summary.zh_hant: 國慶黃金周假期第二日，大批內地旅客湧入香港各大商場及店舖，旺角購物區中午已人頭湧湧，知名相機商場星際城市門外大排長龍。假期首日本港錄得逾27.73萬內地旅客入境，佔總入境人次約47%；次日截至上午10時已有逾6.88萬人次到港。預計整個黃金周本港將迎接約129萬內地旅客。

title.en: Mainland Chinese visitors pack Hong Kong malls on second day of National Day break

summary.en: US AI firm Anthropic appears to have stepped up enforcement of Claude's geographic restrictions in Hong Kong, with a number of local users reporting sudden account suspensions after accessing the service via virtual private networks. Claude has never officially launched in Hong Kong, and many residents have relied on VPNs to use it; the crackdown suggests AI companies are tightening enforcement of regional usage policies.
summary.zh_hans: 美国 AI 公司 Anthropic 疑似加强执行 Claude 在香港的地域限制，多名香港用户反映经虚拟私人网络（VPN）使用服务后，账户突然被停用，令一众用户措手不及。Claude 一直未在香港正式提供服务，不少港人靠 VPN 跨区使用；是次收紧行动反映 AI 公司正加大对地域使用政策的执法力度。
summary.zh_hant: 美國 AI 公司 Anthropic 疑似加強執行 Claude 在香港的地域限制，多名香港用戶反映經虛擬私人網絡（VPN）使用服務後，帳戶突然被停用，令一眾用戶措手不及。Claude 一直未在香港正式提供服務，不少港人靠 VPN 跨區使用；是次收緊行動反映 AI 公司正加大對地域使用政策的執法力度。

title.en: Hong Kong users caught off guard as Anthropic tightens VPN access to Claude

陳茂波：慢病共治計劃26萬人參加提早達標　將涵蓋更多慢性疾病
title.zh_hans: 陈茂波：慢病共治计划26万人参加提早达标　将涵盖更多慢性疾病
title.en: Paul Chan: chronic disease co-care scheme hits 260,000 enrolments early, to cover more conditions

summary.zh_hant: 財政司司長陳茂波表示，「慢病共治計劃」自2023年11月推出以來已有26萬人參加，提早達到三年先導期20萬人的目標，約六成參加者已完成篩查。計劃今年3月起恆常化並納入基層醫療共同治理網絡，未來會擴展至涵蓋更多慢性疾病，讓市民在社區得到更全面、全周期的健康管理服務。
summary.zh_hans: 财政司司长陈茂波表示，“慢病共治计划”自2023年11月推出以来已有26万人参加，提早达到三年先导期20万人的目标，约六成参加者已完成筛查。计划今年3月起恒常化并纳入基层医疗共同治理网络，未来会扩展至涵盖更多慢性疾病，让市民在社区得到更全面、全周期的健康管理服务。
summary.en: Financial Secretary Paul Chan said the Chronic Disease Co-Care Pilot Scheme has enrolled 260,000 people since its November 2023 launch, exceeding its three-year target of 200,000 ahead of schedule, with about 60% completing screenings. Regularised in March under the primary healthcare network, the scheme will expand to cover more chronic conditions for fuller community-based care.

The Hong Kong Observatory said a northeast monsoon will affect the south China coast over the weekend, with an upper-air disturbance bringing showers and thunderstorms to some districts on Saturday. A monsoon replenishment arriving Sunday night will turn winds fresher, with the urban minimum falling to about 24°C on Tuesday and Wednesday. Mid-to-late next week is expected to become generally fine and dry under the persistent dry monsoon.
summary.zh_hant: 天文台表示，東北季候風會在周末期間影響華南，高空擾動亦會為該區帶來驟雨，本港明日初時部份地區驟雨較多及有雷暴。另一股季候風補充將於星期日晚抵達廣東沿岸，下周初風勢較大，市區最低氣溫於下周二、三降至約24度。受乾燥季候風持續影響，下周中後期將普遍晴朗乾燥。
summary.zh_hans: 天文台表示，东北季候风会在周末期间影响华南，高空扰动亦会为该区带来骤雨，本港明日初时部分地区骤雨较多及有雷暴。另一股季候风补充将于星期日晚抵达广东沿岸，下周初风势较大，市区最低气温于下周二、三降至约24度。受干燥季候风持续影响，下周中后期将普遍晴朗干燥。

title.en: Northeast monsoon to bring showers and 24°C lows early next week, Observatory says

summary.en: Ethiopia and Eritrea broke diplomatic ties on Thursday, accusing each other of stoking internal conflicts as heavy fighting continued in northern Ethiopia between government forces and the Tigray People's Liberation Front. Addis Ababa said it would expel 10 Eritrean diplomats and shut its embassy in Asmara, prompting Asmara to reciprocate. Hundreds have been killed or wounded since fighting resumed last week, raising fears of a return to the 2020-22 civil war.
summary.zh_hant: 埃塞俄比亞與厄立特里亞周四斷絕外交關係，雙方互相指責煽動內部衝突；與此同時，埃塞俄比亞北部政府軍與提格雷人民解放陣線的激烈戰鬥持續。亞的斯亞貝巴表示將驅逐10名厄立特里亞外交官並關閉駐阿斯馬拉大使館，厄方隨即以相同措施回應。上周戰鬥重燃以來已有數百人死傷，外界憂慮局勢重演2020至22年內戰。
summary.zh_hans: 埃塞俄比亚与厄立特里亚周四断绝外交关系，双方互相指责煽动内部冲突；与此同时，埃塞俄比亚北部政府军与提格雷人民解放阵线的激烈战斗持续。亚的斯亚贝巴表示将驱逐10名厄立特里亚外交官并关闭驻阿斯马拉大使馆，厄方随即以相同措施回应。上周战斗重燃以来已有数百人死伤，外界忧虑局势重演2020至22年内战。

title.en: Ethiopia and Eritrea sever diplomatic ties as northern fighting escalates

summary.en: US prosecutors allege that a California technology chief executive channelled more than US$300 million of restricted AI servers and GPUs to China via Malaysia and Singapore in 2023-24 using falsified documents, with more than US$176 million in flows. Related funding allegedly supported over 700 servers, including 32 Nvidia Blackwell systems destined for a China Mobile data centre in Ningxia, as Nvidia investigates partner compliance. The cases, which remain allegations pending trial, highlight grey supply chains testing US export controls.
summary.zh_hant: 美國檢方指控，加州一間科技公司行政總裁在2023至24年間，透過馬來西亞及新加坡將總值逾3億美元的受管制AI伺服器及顯示卡轉運往中國，並涉嫌偽造文件，涉及資金逾1.76億美元。另一宗資金安排亦被指支援逾700台伺服器，包括32台輝達Blackwell系統，目標為中國移動位於寧夏的數據中心；輝達正調查合作夥伴合規情況。有關指控仍待審訊，但已突顯灰色供應鏈如何挑戰美國出口管制。
summary.zh_hans: 美国检方指控，加州一家科技公司行政总裁在2023至24年间，通过马来西亚及新加坡将总值逾3亿美元的受管制AI服务器及显卡转运往中国，并涉嫌伪造文件，涉及资金逾1.76亿美元。另一宗资金安排亦被指支援逾700台服务器，包括32台英伟达Blackwell系统，目标为中国移动位于宁夏的数据中心；英伟达正调查合作伙伴合规情况。有关指控仍待审讯，但已突显灰色供应链如何挑战美国出口管制。

title.en: US chip-smuggling cases expose Nvidia supply-chain blind spots

summary.en: HKEX chief executive Bonnie Chan said the exchange will keep optimising its listing framework to make it easier for mainland enterprises to list in Hong Kong, including tailor-made chapters for AI, biotech and new-energy firms with heavy research spending. She said HKEX will also build a multi-asset ecosystem across fixed income, currencies and commodities, and introduce more yuan-denominated products. The reforms aim to consolidate Hong Kong's status as an international financial centre under the national 15th Five-Year Plan.
summary.zh_hant: 港交所行政總裁陳翊庭表示，交易所將繼續優化上市框架，便利內地企業來港上市，包括為人工智能、生物科技及新能源等研發投入龐大的企業設立量身訂造的上市章節。她又指，港交所會建立涵蓋固定收益、貨幣及商品的多資產生態圈，並推出更多人民幣計價產品。改革旨在鞏固香港國際金融中心地位，對接國家第十五個五年規劃。
summary.zh_hans: 港交所行政总裁陈翊庭表示，交易所将继续优化上市框架，便利内地企业来港上市，包括为人工智能、生物科技及新能源等研发投入庞大的企业设立量身订造的上市章节。她又指，港交所会建立涵盖固定收益、货币及商品的多资产生态圈，并推出更多人民币计价产品。改革旨在巩固香港国际金融中心地位，对接国家第十五个五年规划。

title.en: HKEX to keep refining IPO system for mainland firms, CEO says

summary.en: Guangdong's culture and tourism department said the province's 4A-rated and above scenic areas received 2.906 million visitors on October 1, the first day of the National Day holiday, up 6.1% year on year. Red tourism sites, rural destinations and public cultural venues also recorded growth. Scenic areas across the province combined performances, intangible-heritage shows and food events with sightseeing to build holiday consumption scenes.
summary.zh_hant: 廣東省文化和旅遊廳通報，10月1日國慶假期首日，全省4A級及以上景區接待遊客290.6萬人次，按年增長6.1%。紅色旅遊景區、鄉村旅遊點及重點公共文化機構接待量亦錄得增長。全省多地將文藝演出、非遺展示及美食活動與景區遊覽結合，打造節日文旅消費場景。
summary.zh_hans: 广东省文化和旅游厅通报，10月1日国庆假期首日，全省4A级及以上景区接待游客290.6万人次，按年增长6.1%。红色旅游景区、乡村旅游点及重点公共文化机构接待量亦录得增长。全省多地将文艺演出、非遗展示及美食活动与景区游览结合，打造节日文旅消费场景。

title.en: Guangdong's top scenic areas receive 2.9 million visitors on Golden Week day one

summary.en: Hong Kong Customs seized about 360,000 suspected illicit cigarettes, with an estimated market value of about HK$1.88 million, from an inbound vegetable truck at Man Kam To Control Point on September 30. The cigarettes were concealed in 63 foam boxes mixed with vegetables, and a 62-year-old local male driver was arrested and released on bail pending further investigation. Customs reminded the public that importing or exporting unmanifested cargo carries a maximum penalty of a HK$2 million fine and seven years' imprisonment.
summary.zh_hant: 香港海關9月30日在文錦渡管制站一輛入境菜車內，檢獲約36萬支懷疑私煙，估計市值約188萬港元。私煙藏於63個混雜蔬菜的發泡膠箱內，一名62歲本地男司機被捕，其後獲准保釋候查。海關提醒，進出口未列艙載貨物的最高刑罰為罰款200萬港元及監禁7年。
summary.zh_hans: 香港海关9月30日在文锦渡管制站一辆入境菜车内，检获约36万支怀疑私烟，估计市值约188万港元。私烟藏于63个混杂蔬菜的发泡胶箱内，一名62岁本地男司机被捕，其后获准保释候查。海关提醒，进出口未列舱载货物的最高刑罚为罚款200万港元及监禁7年。

title.en: Customs seizes about 360,000 suspected illicit cigarettes at Man Kam To

summary.en: The Government gazetted six pieces of subsidiary legislation on October 2 to facilitate green marine fuel bunkering in Hong Kong waters, expanding usable anchorage sea area from 645 to 2,877 hectares with seven new anchorages. The amendments, covering pilotage, immigration, dangerous goods and port control rules, will be tabled in the Legislative Council on October 7 under negative vetting. The changes implement follow-up work under the Action Plan on Green Marine Fuel Bunkering promulgated in November 2024.
summary.zh_hant: 政府10月2日刊憲6項附屬法例，便利在香港水域進行綠色船用燃料加注，錨地可用海域由645公頃擴大至2,877公頃，並增設7個錨地。有關修訂涉及領港、入境、危險品及港口管制等法例，將於10月7日提交立法會以先訂立後審議程序處理，落實2024年11月公布的《綠色船用燃料加注行動計劃》後續工作。

summary.en: The Hang Seng Index reopened after the holiday down 513 points, or 2.09%, at 24,099 and briefly fell below 24,000, as overnight bond-market swings and a US 10-year yield at its highest since 2002 weighed on sentiment. HSBC and Standard Chartered fell more than 5%, while New World bucked the trend with gains near 10% after its 11 SKIES handover. Investors awaited US non-farm payrolls, expected to rise 90,000 with unemployment at 4.1%, while mainland markets remain closed until October 7.
summary.zh_hant: 恒生指數假期後復市低開513點或2.09%，報24,099點，其後一度跌穿24,000點，隔夜債市波動及美國10年期債息升至2002年以來高位拖累氣氛。滙控及渣打跌逾5%，新世界則因11 SKIES交還安排逆市升近一成。市場觀望美國非農就業數據，預期新增9萬個職位、失業率4.1%；內地股市休市至10月7日。

summary.en: At the IROS 2026 robotics conference in Pittsburgh, a Nanyang Technological University team won the quadruped robot challenge using a Chinese-made robot, the second straight title for teams running Chinese machines. Industry data cited in the report put China's share of global humanoid robot shipments above 97% in the first half of the year. Chinese quadruped robots are now deployed in power inspection, petrochemicals, fire services and emergency work as embodied intelligence shifts from demonstrations to real tasks.
summary.zh_hant: 在美國匹茲堡舉行的IROS 2026機械人會議上，新加坡南洋理工大學戰隊使用中國研製的四足機械人奪得挑戰賽冠軍，為連續第二屆有參賽隊憑中國機械人勝出。報道引述數據指，今年上半年中國人形機械人出貨量佔全球97%以上。四足機械人已應用於電力巡檢、石化、消防及應急等場景，具身智能正由演示走向實際工作。
summary.zh_hans: 在美国匹兹堡举行的IROS 2026机器人会议上，新加坡南洋理工大学战队使用中国研制的四足机器人夺得挑战赛冠军，为连续第二届有参赛队凭中国机器人胜出。报道引述数据指，今年上半年中国人形机器人出货量占全球97%以上。四足机器人已应用于电力巡检、石化、消防及应急等场景，具身智能正由演示走向实际工作。

title.en: Embodied robots move from Chinese mass production to global deployment

summary.en: China's National Day holiday turned major expressways into car parks, with the transport ministry estimating 340 million cross-regional trips on October 1 alone and highway traffic of up to 71 million vehicles. The Shenzhen-Zhongshan Link was dubbed a 'century jam' as vehicles covered just 500 metres in an hour, with travellers playing badminton and cooking hotpot on the roadway. Authorities expect congestion to persist through the Golden Week break.
summary.zh_hant: 內地十一黃金周令多條高速公路變成停車場，交通運輸部估算10月1日單日跨區域流動達3.4億人次，高速公路流量高達7,100萬輛。深中通道被形容為「世紀大塞車」，車輛一小時僅行駛500米，有旅客在路面上打羽毛球及打邊爐。當局預料黃金周期間擠塞情況仍將持續。
summary.zh_hans: 内地十一黄金周令多条高速公路变成停车场，交通运输部估算10月1日单日跨区域流动达3.4亿人次，高速公路流量高达7,100万辆。深中通道被形容为“世纪大塞车”，车辆一小时仅行驶500米，有旅客在路面上打羽毛球及打边炉。当局预料黄金周期间挤塞情况仍将持续。

title.en: National Day gridlock turns China's highways into car parks

summary.en: The Saudi-led coalition accused Yemen's Houthis of striking the Taibah electricity distribution station in Medina with a drone on September 29, taking one transformer out of service without affecting the wider network. Several Muslim countries condemned the alleged attack on the holy city. A senior Houthi official denied responsibility for attacks on the holy sites, according to Houthi media.
summary.zh_hant: 沙特領導的聯軍指控，也門胡塞武裝於9月29日以無人機襲擊聖城麥地那的泰巴赫配電站，令一台變壓器停運，但未影響整體電網。多個穆斯林國家譴責這宗針對聖城的指稱襲擊。據胡塞媒體報道，一名胡塞高級官員否認對聖地襲擊負責。
summary.zh_hans: 沙特领导的联军指控，也门胡塞武装于9月29日以无人机袭击圣城麦地那的泰巴赫配电站，令一台变压器停运，但未影响整体电网。多个穆斯林国家谴责这宗针对圣城的指称袭击。据胡塞媒体报道，一名胡塞高级官员否认对圣地袭击负责。

title.en: Houthis accused of drone attack on Medina power station

summary.en: Japanese government data showed Tokyo's consumer price index and core CPI both rose 2.7% year on year in September, a 10-month high, with core inflation beating expectations. As a leading indicator for nationwide trends, the data will feed into the Bank of Japan's new quarterly forecasts at its policy meeting later this month, strengthening expectations of further rate hikes despite fuel subsidies keeping core inflation below target.
summary.zh_hant: 日本政府數據顯示，東京9月消費物價指數及核心通脹按年同升2.7%，同創10個月新高，核心升幅超出預期。東京數據被視為全國趨勢領先指標，將影響日本央行本月底政策會議的新一季通脹預測；儘管政府提供燃油補貼，批發通脹急升、中東衝突及日圓走弱等因素正加劇價格壓力，強化進一步加息預期。
summary.zh_hans: 日本政府数据显示，东京9月消费物价指数及核心通胀按年同升2.7%，同创10个月新高，核心升幅超出预期。东京数据被视为全国趋势领先指标，将影响日本央行本月底政策会议的新一季通胀预测；尽管政府提供燃油补贴，批发通胀急升、中东冲突及日元走弱等因素正加剧价格压力，强化进一步加息预期。

title.en: Tokyo inflation hits 10-month high, strengthening rate-hike expectations

summary.en: Japanese and South Korean shares fell in early trade on October 2, with Japan underperforming. The Nikkei once dropped 790 points and was later down 684 points, or 0.99%, at 68,272. Seoul's Kospi fell more than 0.6% at the open before narrowing losses to 22 points, or 0.32%, at 6,949.
summary.zh_hant: 日韓股市10月2日初段下跌，日股跌幅較大。日經指數一度跌790點，較早時報68272點，跌684點，跌幅0.99%。首爾綜合指數開市後曾跌逾0.6%，其後跌幅收窄，報6949點，跌22點，跌幅0.32%。

summary.en: Saudi Arabia's interior ministry said the FlyDubai captain and first officer injured in a cockpit altercation left Saudi Arabia on Thursday accompanied by a UAE security team after receiving treatment. A preliminary investigation indicated the first officer attacked the captain; both were treated in hospital and flew back to Abu Dhabi after medical clearance. The Dubai–Tel Aviv flight, carrying 174 passengers and eight crew, made an emergency landing at Tabuk on Wednesday.
summary.zh_hant: 沙特阿拉伯內政部表示，迪拜航空駕駛艙衝突事件中受傷的機長及副駕駛員，在沙特接受治療後，周四在阿聯酋安全工作組陪同下離開沙特。初步調查顯示副駕駛員襲擊機長，兩人送院檢查治療，獲醫療許可後返回阿布扎比。涉事航班周三由迪拜飛往特拉維夫，載有174名乘客及8名機組人員，途中宣布緊急狀態並在塔布克機場緊急降落。
summary.zh_hans: 沙特阿拉伯内政部表示，迪拜航空驾驶舱冲突事件中受伤的机长及副驾驶员，在沙特接受治疗后，周四在阿联酋安全工作组陪同下离开沙特。初步调查显示副驾驶员袭击机长，两人送院检查治疗，获医疗许可后返回阿布扎比。涉事航班周三由迪拜飞往特拉维夫，载有174名乘客及8名机组人员，途中宣布紧急状态并在塔布克机场紧急降落。

summary.en: US initial jobless claims fell by 1,000 to 197,000 last week, a near 57-year low and below market expectations, staying under 200,000 for a third week. Planned layoffs in September fell about 20% year on year to roughly 43,300, while planned hiring rose but remained down 23% annually, suggesting firms are still cautious. ISM manufacturing PMI eased 0.1 to 54.5 in September, but input prices jumped, adding to inflation concerns.
summary.zh_hant: 美國上周新申領失業救濟人數減少1000人至19.7萬人，創近57年新低，低於市場預期，並連續3周低於20萬人。企業9月計劃裁員人數按年及按月跌約兩成至約4.33萬人；計劃招聘人數回升但按年仍跌23%，顯示企業不急於增聘。ISM 9月製造業PMI微跌0.1至54.5，但投入價格急升，反映價格壓力持續，加劇通脹擔憂。
summary.zh_hans: 美国上周新申领失业救济人数减少1000人至19.7万人，创近57年新低，低于市场预期，并连续3周低于20万人。企业9月计划裁员人数按年及按月跌约两成至约4.33万人；计划招聘人数回升但按年仍跌23%，显示企业不急于增聘。ISM 9月制造业PMI微跌0.1至54.5，但投入价格急升，反映价格压力持续，加剧通胀担忧。

summary.en: The US dollar index broke above 102, rising about 0.7% to 102.2, its highest in nearly a year and a half, and held around 102 late in the session. The euro and Swiss franc fell to more than 16-month lows, while the Australian dollar tested 0.69 and the New Zealand dollar briefly slipped below 0.56 to a more than 10-month low. The Canadian dollar also hit a near six-month low.
summary.zh_hant: 美元指數突破102關口，高見102.2，升約0.7%，創近1年半新高，尾市守住102水平。歐元、瑞士法郎跌至逾16個月新低；澳元兌美元考驗0.69支持，新西蘭元一度失守0.56創逾10個月低位，加拿大元亦跌至近半年新低。

title.en: Dollar index breaks 102 to near 18-month high

summary.en: A man aged about 40 was found floating in the sea off Salisbury Road in Tsim Sha Tsui on the night of October 1. Police received a report at about 9pm that someone was floating about 30 metres offshore; the man was rescued unconscious and taken to Queen Elizabeth Hospital, where he was later certified dead. Police said no suicide note was found at the scene and the cause of death will be determined after an autopsy.
summary.zh_hant: 一名年約40歲男子昨晚被發現在尖沙咀梳士巴利道對開海面漂浮。警方晚上9時許接獲途人報案，指有人在梳士巴利道30號對開約30米海面漂浮；男子被救起時昏迷，送往伊利沙伯醫院後證實死亡。警方表示現場無檢獲遺書，死因有待驗屍後確定。
summary.zh_hans: 一名年约40岁男子昨晚被发现在尖沙咀梳士巴利道对开海面漂浮。警方晚上9时许接获途人报案，指有人在梳士巴利道30号对开约30米海面漂浮；男子被救起时昏迷，送往伊利沙伯医院后证实死亡。警方表示现场无检获遗书，死因有待验尸后确定。

summary.en: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said Russia is preparing a bilateral meeting between President Vladimir Putin and Chinese President Xi Jinping on the sidelines of next month's APEC summit. Speaking at a forum in Moscow on Thursday, Putin called Russia–China friendship an important factor for global political stability and said he was also ready for a trilateral meeting with Xi and US President Donald Trump, though an agenda would need to be drawn up first.
summary.zh_hant: 俄羅斯克里姆林宮發言人佩斯科夫表示，俄方正籌備總統普京與中國國家主席習近平在下月亞太經合組織峰會期間的雙邊會面。普京周四在莫斯科一個論壇上表示，俄中友好關係是世界政治穩定的重要因素，中國一貫尋求以和平方式解決問題；他亦準備與習近平及美國總統特朗普舉行三方會晤，但首先需要擬定議程。
summary.zh_hans: 俄罗斯克里姆林宫发言人佩斯科夫表示，俄方正筹备总统普京与中国国家主席习近平在下月亚太经合组织峰会期间的双边会面。普京周四在莫斯科一个论坛上表示，俄中友好关系是世界政治稳定的重要因素，中国一贯寻求以和平方式解决问题；他亦准备与习近平及美国总统特朗普举行三方会晤，但首先需要拟定议程。

summary.en: US long-term Treasury yields rose to more than 24-year highs before reversing. The 10-year yield briefly broke 5.34%, hitting about 5.345%, before bargain buying and dovish Federal Reserve comments pulled it back to around 5.24% late in the session. The 30-year yield also touched about 5.694% before easing to 5.61%, while the two-year yield fell more than 14 basis points to about 4.746%.

summary.zh_hans: 美国长债孳息率先升后回，10年期债息一度突破5.34厘，高见约5.345厘，创逾24年新高，其后有买盘趁低吸纳，加上联储局官员近期发表鸽派言论，债息回落至5.24厘附近。30年期债息亦曾升至逾24年高位约5.694厘，尾市回落至5.61厘；两年期债息跌逾14个基点至约4.746厘。

summary.en: International oil prices rose as markets watched Middle East developments and worried about global fuel shortages. Brent crude for December delivery settled at US$102.31 a barrel, up about 4.4%, while New York November crude settled at US$92.87, up 2.7%. Reports said the US was urging Germany and France to tap emergency diesel reserves, or Washington could impose a diesel export ban.
